item.title: 'That’s the kind of town we are': Community steps up for Michigan tornado victims
item.description: Following Friday's tornadoes, the gym at Union City High School transformed into a massive, well-organized logistical hub. The sheer volume of donations in such a short amount of time is staggering.

item.title: Michigan lawmakers push to regulate license plate reader data amid privacy concerns
item.description: Michigan state lawmakers are pushing to regulate automatic license plate readers after years of debate over the surveillance technology in metro Detroit communities.

item.title: GLWA CEO faces questions as Novi boil water advisory continues following water main break
item.description: Novi residents are still under a boil water advisory after a major water main break over the weekend left thousands without water for two days.
